text: In the recurrence y(t+1) = 0.3·y(t) + c·y(t)·Σ_{k=0}^{9} y(t−k) + 1.5·u(t−9)·u(t) + 0.1, what is the coefficient c on the nonlinear feedback term?
explanation: The nonlinear term is 0.05·y(t)·Σ, so c = 0.05. The other values are the other coefficients in the same recurrence: 0.3 (linear AR term), 1.5 (input-product term), 0.1 (constant offset).
